fact: 7News Morocco reports the National School of Administration (ENA) and the Digital Development Agency (ADD) signed a partnership on 22 September 2026 to build digital skills of public-sector workers in digital transformation, AI, data management and change management, with programmes and numbers to be trained not yet announced.
The minister said several partnership agreements were signed for the training and upskilling of young talent and civil servants in various sectors; no course or number trained is given.
